questions: What is a game?
If one player leaves the game, do the others automatically win?
What is an equilibrium?
At equilibrium, does nothing change anymore?
What is welfare?
If welfare rises, is everyone better off?
How does the mechanism work?
If the mechanism is fixed, do the results stay the same?
What is rent?
If the rent disappears, does the owner stop earning anything?
What is utility?
If utility rises, is everyone happier?
What is a signal?
If the signal is clear, can you trust it?
What is an auction?
When the auction ends, does the highest bid always win?
What is a market?
If the market closes, does trading stop for everyone?
What is a surplus?
When the surplus disappears, is there nothing left?
What is a monopoly?
When a monopoly ends, does the richest player win?
What is rationality?
If rationality produces a bad result, was the choice irrational?
What is efficiency?
If efficiency rises, does everyone get more?
What is entry?
If entry is free, can anyone get in?
What is a public good?
If a public good is available, can one person use it up for everyone?
